1.zh: 神的仆人，耶稣基督的使徒保罗，凭着　神选民的信心与敬虔真理的知识，
1.en: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

1.zh: 盼望那无谎言的　神在万古之先所应许的永生，
1.en: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

1.zh: 到了日期，借着传扬的工夫把他的道显明了；这传扬[的责任]是按着　神—我们救主的命令交托了我。
1.en: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

1.zh: [现在]写信给提多，就是照着我们共信之道作我真儿子的。愿恩惠、平安从父　神和我们的救主基督耶稣归与你！
1.en: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

1.zh: 我从前留你在克里特，是要你将那没有办完的事都办整齐了，又照我所吩咐你的，在各城设立长老。
1.en: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

1.zh: 若有无可指责的人，只作一个妇人的丈夫，儿女也是信主的，没有人告他们是放荡不服约束的，[就可以设立]。
1.en: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

1.zh: 监督既是　神的管家，必须无可指责，不任性，不暴躁，不因酒滋事，不打人，不贪无义之财；
1.en: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

1.zh: 乐意接待远人，好善，庄重，公平，圣洁自持；
1.en: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

1.zh: 坚守所教真实的道理，就能将纯正的教训劝化人，又能把争辩的人驳倒了。
1.en: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

1.zh: 因为有许多人不服约束，说虚空话欺哄人；那奉割礼的更是这样。
1.en: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

1.zh: 这些人的口总要堵住。他们因贪不义之财，将不该教导的教导人，败坏人的全家。
1.en: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

1.zh: 有克里特人中的一个本地先知说：「克里特人常说谎话，乃是恶兽，又馋又懒。」
1.en: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

1.zh: 这个见证是真的。所以，你要严严地责备他们，使他们在真道上纯全无疵，
1.en: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

1.zh: 不听犹太人荒谬的言语和离弃真道之人的诫命。
1.en: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

1.zh: 在洁净的人，凡物都洁净；在污秽不信的人，什么都不洁净，连心地和天良也都污秽了。
1.en: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

1.zh: 他们说是认识　神，行事却和他相背；本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，在各样善事上是可废弃的。
1.en: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

2.zh: 但你所讲的总要合乎那纯正的道理。
2.en: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

2.zh: 劝老年人要有节制、端庄、自守，在信心、爱心、忍耐上都要纯全无疵。
2.en: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

2.zh: 又劝老年妇人，举止行动要恭敬，不说谗言，不给酒作奴仆，用善道教训人，
2.en: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

2.zh: 好指教少年妇人，爱丈夫，爱儿女，
2.en: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

2.zh: 谨守，贞洁，料理家务，待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，免得　神的道理被毁谤。
2.en: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

2.zh: 你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样；在教训上要正直、端庄，
2.en: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

2.zh: 言语纯全，无可指责，叫那反对的人，既无处可说我们的不是，便自觉羞愧。
2.en: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

2.zh: [劝]仆人要顺服自己的主人，凡事讨他的喜欢，不可顶撞他，
2.en: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

2.zh: 不可私拿东西，要显为忠诚，以致凡事尊荣我们救主—　神的道。
2.en: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

2.zh: 因为　神救众人的恩典已经显明出来，
2.en: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

2.zh: 教训我们除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情欲，在今世自守、公义、敬虔度日，
2.en: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

2.zh: 等候所盼望的福，并等候至大的　神和我们救主耶稣基督的荣耀显现。
2.en: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

2.zh: 他为我们舍了自己，要赎我们脱离一切罪恶，又洁净我们，特作自己的子民，热心为善。
2.en: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

2.zh: 这些事你要讲明，劝戒人，用各等权柄责备人；不可叫人轻看你。
2.en: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

3.zh: 你要提醒众人，叫他们顺服作官的、掌权的，遵他的命，预备行各样的善事。
3.en: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

3.zh: 不要毁谤，不要争竞，总要和平，向众人大显温柔。
3.en: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

3.zh: 我们从前也是无知、悖逆、受迷惑、服事各样私欲，和宴乐，常存恶毒嫉妒的心，是可恨的，又是彼此相恨。
3.en: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

3.zh: 但到了　神—我们救主的恩慈和他向人所施的慈爱显明的时候，
3.en: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

3.zh: 他便救了我们；并不是因我们自己所行的义，乃是照他的怜悯，借着重生的洗和圣灵的更新。
3.en: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

3.zh: 圣灵就是　神借着耶稣基督—我们救主厚厚浇灌在我们身上的，
3.en: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

3.zh: 好叫我们因他的恩得称为义，可以凭着永生的盼望成为后嗣。
3.en: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

3.zh: 这话是可信的。我也愿你把这些事切切实实地讲明，使那些已信　神的人留心做正经事业。这都是美事，并且与人有益。
3.en: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

3.zh: 要远避无知的辩论和家谱[的空谈]，以及纷争，并因律法而起的争竞，因为这都是虚妄无益的。
3.en: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

3.zh: 分门结党的人，警戒过一两次，就要弃绝他。
3.en: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

3.zh: 因为知道这等人已经背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，还是去做。
3.en: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

3.zh: 我打发亚提马或是推基古到你那里去的时候，你要赶紧往尼哥坡里去见我，因为我已经定意在那里过冬。
3.en: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

3.zh: 你要赶紧给律师西纳和亚波罗送行，叫他们没有缺乏。
3.en: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

3.zh: 并且我们的人要学习正经事业，预备所需用的，免得不结果子。
3.en: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

3.zh: 同我在一处的人都问你安。请代问那些因有信心爱我们的人安。愿恩惠[常]与你们众人同在！
3.en: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
